projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Create sprint 5 quality verification test
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/test_sprint_5_quality_verification.py with import checks for quality modules
Test that src/matching/scoring.py imports cleanly
Test that src/matching/tiered_matcher.py imports cleanly
Test that src/matching/llm_providers.py imports cleanly
All verification tests pass with pytest tests/test_sprint_5_quality_verification.py -v --non-interactive
Mark story as passed by setting passes: true in prd.json
userStories.notes: Created tests/test_sprint_5_quality_verification.py with 8 tests verifying quality module imports and structure. All 3 modules (scoring, tiered_matcher, llm_providers) import cleanly.

userStories.title: Add adaptive embedding similarity thresholds
acceptanceCriteria: Add calculate_adaptive_threshold() function in src/matching/scoring.py
Base threshold adapts based on voiceover length (short <20 chars = +0.05 threshold)
Base threshold adapts based on candidate variance (low variance <0.05 = -0.05 threshold)
Add adaptive_threshold_enabled config option in MatchingConfig (default: true)
Integrate adaptive threshold in TieredMatcher for skip_llm_threshold decision
Add unit test in tests/test_adaptive_threshold.py covering all adjustment factors
userStories.notes: Implemented calculate_adaptive_threshold() with short voiceover (+0.05) and low variance (-0.05) adjustments. Integrated in TieredMatcher.match_segment(). 15 unit tests all pass.

userStories.title: Add negative sampling for LLM reranking
acceptanceCriteria: Add select_negative_sample() function in src/matching/llm_providers.py
Select a negative sample from bottom 25% of candidates by embedding similarity
Include negative sample in LLM prompt with label 'unlikely match' for comparison
Update MATCH_PROMPT template to include negative sample comparison
Add negative_sampling_enabled config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_negative_sampling.py verifying negative selection
userStories.notes: Implemented select_negative_sample() and format_negative_sample_for_prompt() functions. Updated all 3 LLM providers (Gemini, Claude, Ollama) to include negative samples in prompts. Added negative_sampling_enabled config option. 26 unit tests all pass.

userStories.title: Add fallback matching strategy for edge cases
acceptanceCriteria: Add FallbackMatchStrategy class in src/matching/strategies.py
Implement 3 fallback levels: keyword-only, visual-description, generic-broll
Each level has confidence ceiling (0.7, 0.5, 0.3 respectively)
Trigger fallback when primary matching returns confidence <0.4
Add fallback_matching_enabled config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_fallback_matching.py covering all fallback levels
userStories.notes: Implemented FallbackMatchStrategy with 3 levels: L1 keyword-only (ceiling 0.7), L2 visual-description (ceiling 0.5), L3 generic-broll (ceiling 0.3). Added fallback_matching_enabled and fallback_trigger_threshold config options. Created 31 unit tests covering all fallback levels and edge cases.

userStories.title: Add transcript quality scoring
acceptanceCriteria: Add calculate_transcript_quality() function in src/matching/scoring.py
Score based on: word count (>50 = good), sentence coherence, language consistency
Return quality tier: high (>0.8), medium (0.5-0.8), low (<0.5)
Reduce embedding weight by 20% when transcript quality is low
Add transcript_quality_weight config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_transcript_quality.py for quality scoring
userStories.notes: Implemented calculate_transcript_quality() with 3 scoring factors: word count (0-0.4), sentence coherence (0-0.35), language consistency (0-0.25). Added adjust_embedding_weight_for_transcript_quality() to reduce embedding weight by 20% for low-quality transcripts. Added transcript_quality_weight config option. Created 32 unit tests in tests/test_transcript_quality.py covering all quality tiers and edge cases.

userStories.title: Add confidence normalization by candidate pool size
acceptanceCriteria: Add normalize_confidence_by_pool() function in src/matching/scoring.py
Boost confidence when pool is small (<10 candidates) and top match is clear
Reduce confidence when pool is large (>100 candidates) with tight margins
Apply normalization factor: sqrt(pool_size/50) capped at [0.8, 1.2]
Add pool_normalization_enabled config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_pool_normalization.py for pool size effects
userStories.notes: Implemented normalize_confidence_by_pool() with sqrt(pool_size/50) formula capped at [0.8, 1.2]. Small pools (<10) with clear winner (margin >=0.1) get +0.05 boost. Large pools (>100) with tight margin (<0.05) get -0.05 penalty. Added pool_normalization_enabled config option. Created 34 unit tests covering basic cases, small/medium/large pools, factor capping, edge cases, and formula verification. All tests pass.

userStories.title: Add LLM prompt chain-of-thought for match reasoning
acceptanceCriteria: Update MATCH_PROMPT in src/matching/llm_providers.py with chain-of-thought structure
Prompt structure: 1) Identify key voiceover themes, 2) List matching elements in video, 3) Evaluate fit, 4) Score
Add explicit rubric: visual relevance (30%), topic match (40%), keyword overlap (20%), flow (10%)
Parse structured reasoning response into components
Add chain_of_thought_enabled config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_cot_reasoning.py for structured reasoning parsing
userStories.notes: Implemented chain-of-thought prompting with COT_RUBRIC_WEIGHTS (visual 30%, topic 40%, keyword 20%, flow 10%), CotReasoning dataclass for structured parsing, build_cot_prompt/build_cot_batch_prompt functions, parse_cot_reasoning parser, and use_cot parameter on all 3 LLM providers. Added chain_of_thought_enabled config option. Created 28 unit tests in tests/test_cot_reasoning.py covering all components.

userStories.title: Add early termination for obvious high-confidence matches
acceptanceCriteria: Add check_obvious_match() function in src/matching/tiered_matcher.py
Skip LLM when embedding sim >0.9 AND matched_keywords >=3 AND same entity found
Return boosted confidence (min 0.92) with reason 'obvious_match_early_termination'
Log when early termination is triggered with match details
Add obvious_match_enabled config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_early_termination.py for obvious match detection

userStories.title: Add cache quality tier tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Add quality_tier field to LLM cache entries (high/medium/low based on confidence)
Update cache lookup to return quality_tier alongside cached response
Add cache_expire_low_quality config option (default: false)
When enabled, skip cache for entries with quality_tier='low' forcing re-evaluation
Log cache quality tier on hit with confidence range
Add unit test in tests/test_cache_quality_tier.py for tier tracking and expiration

userStories.title: Add multi-modal similarity weighting
acceptanceCriteria: Add compute_multimodal_score() function in src/matching/scoring.py
Weight contributions: text_embedding (40%), keyword_overlap (25%), entity_match (20%), visual_description (15%)
Each component normalized to 0-1 before weighting
Add multimodal_weights config option as dict with default weights
Replace simple additive boosting in TieredMatcher with multimodal score
Add unit test in tests/test_multimodal_scoring.py for weighted fusion

userStories.title: Add semantic coherence between adjacent segments
acceptanceCriteria: Add compute_semantic_coherence() function in src/matching/scoring.py
Compute topic flow: embedding similarity between current and previous match
Apply boost (+0.03) when topic flow is smooth (similarity >0.6)
Apply penalty (-0.05) when topic flow is abrupt (similarity <0.3)
Add semantic_coherence_enabled config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_semantic_coherence.py for topic flow scoring

userStories.title: Add match explanation confidence validation
acceptanceCriteria: Add validate_explanation_confidence() function in src/matching/llm_providers.py
Cross-check that LLM explanation keywords appear in actual voiceover/video text
Downgrade confidence by 0.1 when <50% of explanation keywords are verifiable
Log warning when explanation appears to reference non-existent content
Add explanation_validation_enabled config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_explanation_validation.py for keyword verification
